# Comment

Comment: one entry in a threaded discussion, with slots for the author, time, content, actions and replies.

**Import:** `import { Comment } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/Comment/Comment.jsx`

**Stories:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/Comment/Comment.stories.jsx` — Basic, Saving, Highlighted, Edited, Restricted, WithNestedReplies, Interactive

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/Comment/Comment.mdx`

## Usage

Use a comment for one entry in a threaded discussion: a note on a session, a reply in a review thread. For a single text entry with no author or thread context, use Text area.

## Best practices

### Nest replies through `nestedReplies`, not by composing comments yourself. {#nest-replies-through-nestedreplies-not-by-composing-comments-yourself}

Passing replies through `nestedReplies` opens a heading context at `headingLevel`, so any `Heading` inside the reply tree nests one level deeper automatically. Composing comments directly without this prop skips that step.

```jsx
<Comment
    author="Jane Park"
    time="2h ago"
    content="Looks good to me."
    nestedReplies={<Comment author="Sam Lee" time="1h ago" content="Agreed." />}
/>
```

### Swap `actions` for `savingText` with `isSaving`; do not hide them yourself. {#swap-actions-for-savingtext-with-issaving-do-not-hide-them-yourself}

Set `isSaving` rather than conditionally rendering `actions`. It keeps the saving state in one prop instead of two places making the same decision.

Do: While the reply saves, the saving text replaces the Reply action.
Don't: The Reply action stays live, with nothing to say a reply is saving.

### Show who wrote it and when. {#show-who-wrote-it-and-when}

Every comment names its author and time. Anonymous, undated comments cannot be trusted or followed up.

Do: Author and time are both present.
Don't: No name, no time.

### Write the comment as a plain sentence. {#write-the-comment-as-a-plain-sentence}

Sentence case, normal punctuation. Capitals and stacked marks read as shouting.

Do: A plain question.
Don't: All caps, stacked marks.

### Ask for one clear thing. {#ask-for-one-clear-thing}

Name the action and the detail. An open "Thoughts?" leaves the reader guessing.

Do: One action, one detail.
Don't: No action named.

## Accessibility

- **A real article.** Each comment is an `<article>`, giving assistive technology a landmark per entry in the thread.
- **Replies nest their headings correctly.** Because `nestedReplies` opens its own heading context, a reply thread's headings read in the right outline order rather than all landing at the same level.
- **Restricted visibility is stated, not just implied.** `restrictedTo` renders as visible text in the header, so who can see the comment is not communicated by color or icon alone.

## Parts

1. **Avatar.** Sits beside the comment's content.
2. **Header.** The author, the time, an edited marker and, when restricted, who the comment is visible to.
3. **Content.** The comment body.
4. **Actions**, or **saving text** in their place while a change is in flight.
5. **Nested replies.** Sit below, indented, at one heading level deeper through `headingLevel`.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Saving | The actions give way to the saving text in `--ds-text-subtle`. |
| Highlighted | The comment takes `--ds-background-selected`. |

A comment has no hover, pressed, focus or disabled state of its own. The actions a caller passes in carry theirs.

| Part | Token |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Show the author's name as people know them: "Ari Patel". | A username or an id. |
| Write the time as relative or dated text: "2h ago", "Oct 21". | A raw timestamp: "2026-10-21T14:03:11Z". |
| State who can see a restricted comment: "Visible to staff only". | A lock icon with no words. |
| Name the action in the saving text: "Saving your reply…". | A bare "Loading". |
